question: Does the rebuild generate out-of-band (Collaborator) payloads for the scanner, or only use Collaborator as a passive view? collaborator.rs is large but the scanner does not reference it.
probes: Run a Collaborator-based check in the original
Wire scanner checks to the existing Collaborator client
resolution: RESOLVED 2026-11-15 (wave 10): the scanner DOES generate out-of-band Collaborator payloads. Run active scan generates one payload per URL parameter (ui.rs calls collab_state.generate_payload()), passes (param_name, token, marker) into scan.rs start_active_scan, which adds an oob probe replacing the parameter value with the payload and registers (token, pre-built issue) in Shared.oob_pending (net.rs); the UI-frame matcher ui.rs sync_oob_issues (Scanner + Dashboard views) matches observed Collaborator interactions against pending tokens and raises the issue with the interaction headline and source. The Collaborator remains usable as a passive view alongside. Suite green: test result: ok. 223 passed; 0 failed (wave 10 run: 114.59s).
